aiConsent.title: Turn on Uni with AI
aiConsent.what: Uni uses Gemini, by Google. Your questions and the files you attach (PDFs, photos, screenshots) are sent to Google to generate the answer.
aiConsent.shared: On the included (free) Uni, Google may use that content to improve its products, and people may review it. Do not send personal or sensitive data.
aiConsent.ownKey: You are using your personal key: your Google account terms apply, and the key stays on this device only.
aiConsent.ageWhy: Google only allows Gemini to be used by people aged 18 or over.
aiConsent.off: You can turn it off at any time in Settings.
